title: pm-dispatch skill: an area hands a security card back to the seat only when it is under disclosure discipline
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgTRf6qBRCqPh4JZaZL

Blocked-by: #35740
Found-in: #35790

## Problem

`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/area-lease.md:50` (main `1e018d6ed`), the last clause of the 留道 line, lists what an area always hands out: `交出闭集:他道在线席已认领、cloud 路由、安全、ADR。` The word `安全` is unqualified, so every `security` card leaves the area for the seat, whatever its size and whether or not it carries private detail.

## Ruling

The maintainer ruled on 2026-11-20 that whether a card runs in its own thread, in an area or in the seat follows its size and shape only, and that only a security card under disclosure discipline stays in the seat session. The ruling record is comment 7033659866 on #35784; the seat reads this line as inside that ruling. #35784 (PR #35790) changes the two routing lines in `dispatch-runbook.md` and `SKILL.md`; it leaves this file alone because open PR #35740 edits it.

## What changes

- The hand-out set names security cards under disclosure discipline (private detail that may not leave the seat session), not every security card. A security card without that discipline is routed by size like any other card.
- Sweep the file for any other line that hands a card out of an area because it is `security` alone.

## Constraints

- `.claude/**` is governed: the PR body carries `Rule-change: ruled` and `Ruling-ref: 7033659866`; the L2 record must read `Rule-change-verified: ruled`.
- The file is under the byte ratchet at headroom 0: fit the text by compressing the same file, no ceiling raise.
- Start only after #35740 merges (same file).

## Done when

- `area-lease.md` hands a security card to the seat only under disclosure discipline, and agrees with the card-thread section of `dispatch-runbook.md` as #35790 leaves it.

Filed by area b1-D at the seat's request; not claimed, not started.
